subject: Post-POC summary & quick ask: 10-15m quote for efficiency playbook
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@parcelflux.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-POC summary & quick ask: 10-15m quote for efficiency playbook

Hi Derek —

Thanks again for running the week-long POC with us. Attached is a short one-page summary of the metrics we observed during the trial (ParcelFlux_pilot_kpis.pdf) and the latency/throughput chart I promised (poc_latency_chart.png). Quick highlights from the POC:

- 42% reduction in mean inference cost per order (tokenized pipeline) vs your current hosted solution
- Median end-to-end latency at 95th percentile: 180ms (windowed workloads)
- Cache hit rate average: 38% for repeat prefix patterns in checkout flows
- Estimated annualized savings at current load: ~$140k (conservative)

We want to showcase a compact case example of the ParcelFlux pilot in our efficiency playbook. Would you be open to two quick things?

1) A 10-15 minute recorded quote (audio or video) — just a couple of lines on the impact (we can send bullet prompts).
2) A single-sentence permission to use ParcelFlux as a short reference on our site and in sales collateral.

If you’re up for the recording, Marcus (cc’d) can run the call and keep it under 15 minutes. Can you share availability this week or next?

Thanks again for partnering on this — the team was great to collaborate with.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments:
- ParcelFlux_pilot_kpis.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
- poc_latency_chart.png (PNG, figure)
From: Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@parcelflux.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-POC summary & quick ask: 10-15m quote for efficiency playbook

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the clear summary and the PDF — looks accurate to our internal numbers. Quick confirmations from our side:

- The cost reduction estimate matches our billing comparison for April (yep, ~40–45% lower).
- Latency numbers line up with our end-to-end traces; 95th at ~180–200ms during peak batch windows.
- Cache behavior was better than I expected — that 38% number seems right for repeat checkout flows.

Happy to do the 10–15 minute recording. I can say something like: “We saw a significant reduction in per-order inference cost and improved p95 latency during our POC with Redwood, which made it an easy economics win for us.”

I’m available Tuesday 11 May 11:30–12:00 or Thursday 13 May 09:00–09:30 PT. Marcus, feel free to pick a slot and share a calendar invite + a couple of prompt bullets to help Derek.

Permission: You have our consent to use ParcelFlux as a short reference and include the savings percentage in marketing material — feel free to cite the 42% figure.

Thanks,
Derek
Derek Shaw
VP of Product | ParcelFlux
derek.shaw@parcelflux.com

Thanks Derek — I scheduled the quick recording for Tuesday 11 May 11:30 PT and sent a calendar invite to your email.

Derek, a few optional prompt bullets to make the clip concise (we’ll record audio only unless you prefer video):
- One-liner about the problem ParcelFlux had (cost/latency pain)
- The measurable improvement you saw in the POC (cost % and p95 latency)
- One sentence on what that improvement enabled (faster checkout, lower infra spend, etc.)

We’ll keep editing minimal; will share the clip for sign-off before using it. If helpful, Marcus attached a short script outline I’ll read from.

See you Tuesday — thanks again.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
